accordion.title: Accordion
accordion.description: Connected, animated panels with shared borders and single or multiple expansion.
accordion.intro: `c2-accordion` combines `c2-details` panels into one disclosure surface: a shared frame, single-line dividers and rounded outside corners. Panels animate open and closed together, and their chevrons rotate with the same timing. Opening a panel closes its siblings by default; add `multiple` to keep several open. All panels can be closed in either mode. Each panel provides its own label, content, disabled state and header slots through `c2-details`.

elements.description:
A connected disclosure surface with shared borders, outside corners and animated panels.
Opening a panel closes its siblings unless `multiple` is set.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allows several panels to remain expanded. All panels may be closed in either mode.

slots.description: Direct `c2-details` children to coordinate.

cssProperties.description: Color of the outer frame and shared panel dividers.

cssProperties.name: --c2-accordion--border-radius
cssProperties.description: Outside corner radius. With a positive gap, applies to every panel.

cssProperties.description: Panel and chevron animation duration. Set to 0ms for instant toggling; respects reduced motion.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.description: Image, initials or icon for a person, with status dot and badge.
avatar.intro: `c2-avatar` shows a person or entity. It resolves its content in order: the `src` image (a broken image fires `error` and falls back to the initials), then slotted content such as an icon or emoji, then the initials computed from `name`. `initial-count="2"` picks the first and last word of a longer name, and `initials` overrides the computation. `auto-color` derives a stable background hue from the name, `status` adds a presence dot, and the `badge` slot replaces the dot with your own element. One `--c2-avatar--size` token drives the width, height and font size.

elements.description:
Shows a person or entity as an image, initials or any slotted content, with an optional status dot or badge.

Resolution order: the `src` image (falling back to initials if it fails to load), then slotted content, then the
initials computed from `name`. Set `auto-color` to derive a stable background hue from the name.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full name: source of the initials, the accessible label and the `auto-color` hue.

attributes.name: initial-count
attributes.description: Number of initials to show. With 2 and a name of three or more words, the first and last word are used.

attributes.name: initials
attributes.description: Explicit initials; overrides the ones computed from `name`.

attributes.name: src
attributes.description: Image URL. Falls back to the initials when the image fails to load.

attributes.name: alt
attributes.description: Image alt text; defaults to `name`.

attributes.name: auto-color
attributes.description: Derive a stable background hue from `name` (same name, same color).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Presence dot in the bottom-right corner.

slots.description: Custom content shown instead of the initials (an icon, an emoji, an ``).

slots.name: badge
slots.description: Small element pinned to the bottom-right corner (a count, an icon). Replaces the `status` dot.

events.name: error
events.description: Fired when the `src` image fails to load; the initials are shown instead.

cssProperties.name: --c2-avatar--height

cssProperties.description: e.g. `0 0 0 2px #fff` for a ring in stacked groups.

badge.title: Badge
badge.description: Tinted pill for status text, counts and dots, optionally pinned to a corner of another element.
badge.intro: `c2-badge` labels a state in a small tinted pill. Six `tone`s carry meaning (neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info) and each is a background/text variable pair, so a design system recolours them without touching markup. Give it a `count` to show a number clamped at `max` (`99+`), or `dot` for a presence indicator that can `pulse`. Put an element in the `anchor` slot and the badge pins itself to one of its corners chosen with `placement`, the classic notification count on an icon button. `--c2-badge--background` and `--c2-badge--color` override whichever tone is active.

elements.description:
Small status label: a tinted pill with text, a number or an icon, or a plain dot. Six `tone`s carry meaning
(neutral, primary, success, warning, danger, info); each is a pair of CSS variables so a design system can recolour
them without touching the markup. Give it a `count` to show a number clamped at `max` (`99+`), or `dot` for a
presence indicator that can `pulse`. Put an element in the `anchor` slot and the badge pins itself to one of its
corners (`placement`), for example a notification count on an icon button; `overlap="circular"` moves it onto the
edge of a round anchor such as an avatar.

attributes.name: tone
attributes.description: Colour role of the badge.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: Number to display instead of the slotted text. Hidden when it is `0` unless `show-zero` is set.

attributes.name: max
attributes.description: Upper bound for `count`; larger values render as `<max>+`.

attributes.name: show-zero
attributes.description: Keeps a `count` of `0` visible.

attributes.name: dot
attributes.description: Renders a small dot without text.

attributes.name: pulse
attributes.description: Animates a fading ring around a `dot` badge to draw attention.

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Corner of the `anchor` element the badge is pinned to.

attributes.name: overlap
attributes.description: Shape of the anchor: `circular` pulls the badge onto the edge of a round anchor instead of its bounding-box corner.

slots.description: Label text. Ignored while `count` or `dot` is set.

slots.name: prefix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown before the text, sized by `--c2-badge__icon--size`.

slots.name: anchor
slots.description: Element the badge is pinned to. When filled the badge becomes an overlay at the `placement` corner.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--min-width
cssProperties.description: Keeps single digits round.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the icon and the text.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--border
cssProperties.description: Set a border for an outlined look, together with a transparent background.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--background
cssProperties.description: Overrides the tone background.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge--color
cssProperties.description: Overrides the tone text colour.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__dot--size
cssProperties.description: Diameter of the `dot` badge; its colour is the tone text colour.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__pulse--animation-duration
cssProperties.description: Length of one `pulse` cycle; respects reduced motion.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--border
cssProperties.description: Ring around an anchored badge, in the page background colour. Drawn outside a `dot`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--offset-x
cssProperties.description: Moves an anchored badge inwards horizontally (`14.6%` with `overlap="circular"`).

cssProperties.name: --c2-badge__anchor--offset-y
cssProperties.description: Moves an anchored badge inwards vertically (`14.6%` with `overlap="circular"`).

breadcrumb.title: Breadcrumb
breadcrumb.description: Navigation trail of link buttons with separators, a current page and optional collapsing.
breadcrumb.intro: `c2-breadcrumb` shows where the user is in a hierarchy. Every child is one item: use `c2-link-button` with an `href` for the ancestors and either a link button or a plain element for the current page. The last item is marked as the current page automatically (`aria-current="page"`) and styled as text, and a separator is drawn between items, a chevron by default or the content of the `separator` slot. The trail always stays on one row: when it does not fit, items collapse behind an ellipsis in priority order (the current page always, then the first item, then the items closest to the current page), and `max-items` caps the visible count even when there is room. Clicking the ellipsis reveals every item. The whole trail sits in a `nav` landmark labelled "Breadcrumb" (override with `aria-label`).

elements.description:
Navigation trail. Every light-DOM child is one item, typically a `c2-link-button` with an `href`, and the last one
is the current page: it is marked `aria-current="page"` (through `selected` on a link button) and styled as text.
A separator is drawn between items, a chevron by default or whatever is placed in the `separator` slot. The trail
stays on one row: when the items do not fit the available width, some collapse behind an ellipsis, in priority
order: the current page is always shown, then the first item, then the items closest to the current page while room
remains. `max-items` caps how many are shown even when there is room. Clicking the ellipsis reveals every item
(wrapping if needed).

attributes.name: max-items
attributes.description: Upper bound on visible items (the first, then the last ones behind an ellipsis). `0` lets the width decide alone.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the navigation landmark.

slots.description: The items, in order. Use `c2-link-button` for links; any element works for the current page.

slots.name: separator
slots.description: Custom separator, cloned between every pair of items (text such as `/`, or an icon).

cssProperties.name: --c2-breadcrumb--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between an item and its separator.

cssProperties.name: --c2-breadcrumb__separator--size
cssProperties.description: Icon size and font size of the separator.

button.title: Button
button.description: Themeable button with slots for text, prefix, suffix and running icons.
button.intro: `c2-button` is a filled button whose label, prefix icon, suffix icon and running indicator are all slots. Set `running` while an action is in flight: clicks are ignored and the `running-icon` slot (a spinner by default) takes the place of the prefix icon.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the button: it no longer receives clicks and is rendered dimmed.

attributes.name: running
attributes.description: Marks the button as busy: clicks are ignored and the `running-icon` slot replaces the prefix icon.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (`aria-pressed="true"`); styled with the `container__selected--*` variables.

attributes.name: toggle
attributes.description: Declares a toggle button: `aria-pressed` is announced as `false` while not selected. Set by `c2-button-group` in selection modes.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Button label text.

slots.name: prefix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown before the label. Replaced by `running-icon` while the button is running.

slots.name: suffix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown after the label.

slots.name: running-icon
slots.description: Icon shown in place of the prefix icon while `running` is set. Defaults to a spinner; the slot wrapper rotates, so slotted content spins too.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button__container__selected--background-color
cssProperties.description: Pressed state of a toggle button (see `selected`).

button-group.title: Button Group
button-group.description: Attached buttons with shared borders, optionally a segmented control with single or multiple selection.
button-group.intro: `c2-button-group` attaches related `c2-button` or `c2-icon-button` elements into one control: shared borders, rounded outside corners only and a divider between items. On its own it is a layout: the buttons keep their own behaviour and clicks. Add `selection="single"` and it becomes a segmented control that keeps exactly one item pressed, or `selection="multiple"` to let each item toggle independently; the pressed items carry `selected` (which the buttons announce as `aria-pressed`) and the group reports them in `value` and fires `change`. A positive `--c2-button-group--gap` separates the items into individually rounded buttons instead.

elements.description:
Attaches related buttons into one control: shared borders, outside corners only, a divider between items. Children
are `c2-button` or `c2-icon-button` elements (any element works for layout). With `selection="single"` the group is
a segmented control that keeps one item pressed; with `selection="multiple"` each item toggles independently. The
pressed items carry `selected` (and `aria-pressed`), the group reports them in `value` and fires `change`.

attributes.name: selection
attributes.description: `none` (default) for plain attached buttons, `single` for one pressed item, `multiple` for independent toggles.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: `value` of the pressed item; comma-separated values with `selection="multiple"`. Items without a `value` attribute use their index.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables every item.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Stacks the items vertically.

attributes.name: aria-label
attributes.description: Accessible name of the group.

slots.description: The buttons, in order.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the new `value`. Not fired for programmatic changes.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between items. Zero attaches them; a positive gap separates them into individually rounded buttons.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--border-radius
cssProperties.description: Outside corner radius. With a positive gap, applies to every item.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group--border
cssProperties.description: Border applied to every item, e.g. `1px solid #d4d4d8` for an outlined group.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__divider--width
cssProperties.description: Width of the line between attached items; also how much their borders overlap.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__divider--color
cssProperties.description: Colour of the line between attached items. Match the border colour for outlined groups, `transparent` for none.

cssProperties.name: --c2-button-group__item--flex
cssProperties.description: `1 1 0` makes every item grow to the same width.

card.title: Card
card.description: Groups related content and actions on a single bordered surface.
card.intro: `c2-card` is a surface with four optional sections: `media` (an image or any block that bleeds to the edges and is clipped to the card radius), `header`, the default slot for the body, and `footer` (a flex row for actions). A section is rendered only when its slot has content, so a bare `<c2-card>text</c2-card>` is just a padded box. Set `href` to make the whole card a link, or `interactive` to give it button semantics (focusable, Enter and Space click it). `disabled` dims the card and blocks interaction. Hover, focus and disabled looks are all tokens; `--c2-card__hover--transform` with a hover shadow gives the classic lift.

elements.description:
Surface that groups related content and actions. The body goes in the default slot; `media`, `header` and `footer`
are optional sections that render only when filled: media bleeds to the edges at the top, header and footer get
their own padding and divider tokens. With `href` the whole card is a link; with `interactive` it behaves like a
button (focusable, Enter and Space click it). Hover, focus and disabled looks are themeable.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dims the card and ignores pointer and keyboard interaction. A link card renders without its anchor.

attributes.name: interactive
attributes.description: Button-like card: focusable, `role="button"`, Enter and Space dispatch `click`, pointer cursor. Implied by `href`.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the whole card a link.

slots.description: Card body.

slots.name: media
slots.description: Full-bleed image, video or any block shown above the body; it is clipped to the card radius.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Title area above the body.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Actions row below the body (a flex row, see the `footer--*` tokens).

cssProperties.name: --c2-card--color
cssProperties.description: Text color of the card; inherits by default.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__header--padding-top
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-top`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__header--padding-right
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-right`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__header--padding-left
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-left`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__header--border-bottom
cssProperties.description: Divider under the header; raise `header--padding-bottom` with it.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__footer--padding-right
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-right`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__footer--padding-bottom
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-bottom`.

cssProperties.name: --c2-card__footer--padding-left
cssProperties.description: Falls back to `--c2-card--padding-left`.

cssProperties.description: Divider above the footer; raise `footer--padding-top` with it.

checkbox.title: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Native checkbox behaviour in a quiet, themeable box with an opt-in hover layer.
checkbox.intro: `c2-checkbox` wraps a native `<input type="checkbox">`, so `checked`, `indeterminate`, `disabled`, `name` and the `change` event behave exactly like the built-in control. The visible box sits centred in a square touch target whose size is `--c2-checkbox__state-layer--size`; that same square is the hover layer, transparent by default. Set a `state-layer__hover__*--color` to tint it, or shrink it to the box size for a compact inline checkbox. Keyboard focus draws a ring around the box. The three marks are slots that take an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon` ligature.

elements.description:
A checkbox with native `<input type="checkbox">` behaviour. The visible box sits centred in a square touch target
(`state-layer--size`) that doubles as the hover layer; that layer is transparent unless a
`state-layer__hover__*--color` is set, so the default look is quiet.

code-viewer.title: Code Viewer
code-viewer.description: Syntax-highlighted code with line numbers, copy button and dark mode, powered by shiki.
code-viewer.intro: `c2-code-viewer` renders source code highlighted by [shiki](https://shiki.style/). Put the code in the default slot, as text inside a `<pre>` or markup inside a `<template>` (indentation is stripped), or set the `code` property; a literal `\n` in the attribute stands for a newline. `language` accepts any shiki language id or alias, `theme` any built-in theme or `css-variables`. Grammars and themes are loaded on demand into one shared highlighter with shiki's JavaScript engine, and the plain code renders immediately, server-side too, then upgrades in place. Add `dark-theme` for a light and dark pair switched by `color-scheme` (`auto` follows the OS), `line-numbers`, `highlight-lines="2-4,7"`, `copyable` (fires `code-copy`), `wrap`, `inline`, and a `title` slot for a file name header.

elements.description:
Syntax-highlighted source code powered by shiki. Grammars and themes are loaded on demand into one shared
highlighter, so many viewers on a page cost one engine. The raw code renders immediately as plain text (also on the
server) and is upgraded in place once highlighted.

Source: the `code` property, or the default slot. Wrap slotted text in a `<pre>` (formatters such as Prettier collapse
whitespace inside custom elements but leave `<pre>` alone) and markup samples in a `<template>` so the browser does
not parse them. Common indentation is stripped.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Source code. When unset, the default slot's text is used. A literal `\n` counts as a newline when the text has none.

attributes.name: language
attributes.description:
Language id or alias (`ts`, `html`, `bash`, `diff`, …). Unknown values render as plain text. (Not `lang`: that is the
global attribute for the natural language of the element's text and is read by assistive technology.)

attributes.name: theme
attributes.description: shiki theme name, or `css-variables`.

attributes.name: dark-theme
attributes.description: Second theme for dark mode. When set both palettes are rendered and `color-scheme` picks one.

attributes.name: color-scheme
attributes.description: Which palette to show when `dark-theme` is set: follow the OS (`auto`), or force one.

attributes.name: wrap
attributes.description: Soft-wrap long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Render as an inline `<code>` fragment (no frame, no header).

attributes.name: start-line
attributes.description: First line number when `line-numbers` is on.

attributes.name: highlight-lines
attributes.description: Lines to emphasise, 1-based, e.g. `"2-4,7"`.

attributes.name: copyable
attributes.description: Show a copy-to-clipboard button.

slots.description: Source code, in a `<pre>` (text) or a `<template>` (markup). Ignored when the `code` property is set.

slots.name: title
slots.description: Header label, typically a file name. Shown above the code when present.

slots.name: copy-icon
slots.description: Replaces the default copy icon.

slots.name: copied-icon
slots.description: Replaces the default check icon shown after copying.

events.name: code-copy
events.description: Fired after the copy button put the code on the clipboard.

copy-button.title: Copy Button
copy-button.description: Button that copies text to the clipboard — the element it sits in, another element by id, or a literal string.
copy-button.intro: `c2-copy-button` puts text on the clipboard. Drop it inside the element you want to copy and that is all the configuration it needs: it copies its parent, and leaves its own label out of the result. Point it at something else with `for` (the `id` of the source), or hand it the exact string with `value`. It reads each source the way that source stores its text — the code of a `c2-code-viewer`, the `value` of an input or `c2-text-field`, the rendered text of anything else — so copying a highlighted snippet gives you the code, not a wall of token spans. By default the button stays out of the way until you hover its source, and `pin` parks it in a corner where it stays put even while the source scrolls.

attributes.name: reveal
attributes.description:
`hover` (default) keeps the button transparent until the pointer is over its source, or keyboard focus lands
inside it. `always` shows it permanently. A hover-only button still appears on keyboard focus and on devices
with no hover at all.

The `copied` confirmation deliberately does *not* hold it on screen: once the pointer leaves, the button fades
out with the check still on it and resets off-screen, so the icon never flips back to `copy` on a button the
user has already walked away from.

attributes.name: pin
attributes.description:
Pins the button to a corner of its containing block, staying put while the source scrolls under it.

The bare attribute means `top-right`. The containing block must be positioned (`position: relative` on the
element the button sits in), as with any absolutely positioned child.

details.title: Details
details.description: Collapsible disclosure built on native details and summary.
details.intro: `c2-details` wraps a native `<details>` / `<summary>` pair, so keyboard access, screen-reader semantics and find-in-page auto-expand come from the browser. Give panels the same `name` and they form an exclusive accordion: opening one closes the others. The header is the `title` slot (or the `label` attribute) plus an optional `header-content` row that stays visible when collapsed; buttons and links placed there work without toggling the panel. `title-not-clickable` limits toggling to the chevron, `disabled` blocks it. Open and close slide the content smoothly in every browser (`--c2-details--transition-duration` controls the length, reduced motion disables it), and `expanded` mirrors the native `open` state; listen for `toggle` on the element.

elements.description:
Collapsible disclosure built on native `<details>` / `<summary>`, so keyboard access, screen-reader semantics and
find-in-page auto-expand come from the browser. Panels that share a `name` form an exclusive accordion. Open and
close animate the content height (plus a fade) with the Web Animations API, so the motion is identical in every
browser; the native `open` attribute is only removed once the close animation has finished.

root. (The native `name` attribute cannot be used: each panel's `<details>` sits in its own shadow tree.)

slots.name: header-content

slots.description: Alternative icon shown only while open (replaces the rotation).

list.title: List
list.description: Vertical list container with single or multiple selection.
list.intro: `c2-list` stacks `c2-list-item` rows and owns their selection: it compares each row's `value` with its own `value` and marks the matching rows selected. A click updates `value` and fires `selection-change` with the values and each row's `data`. `multiple` allows several rows, `required` keeps at least one, `disabled` freezes the whole list. The list is a `listbox` with a roving `tabindex`: Arrow Up/Down, Home and End move between rows, Enter and Space select, and typing a few letters jumps to the matching row. `<hr>` dividers and `<h1>`–`<h6>` headings can sit between rows to group them. Set `--c2-list--max-height` to make a long list scroll. It is also the dropdown inside `c2-select`.

elements.description:
A vertical list of `c2-list-item` rows with single or multiple selection. The list owns the selection: it reads the
`value` of the clicked row, updates its own `value` (a `;`-separated list in the attribute, an array in the property)
and pushes the selected state down to every row through context, so rows never need a `selected` attribute of
their own when they live inside a list.

Keyboard: the list is a `listbox` with a roving `tabindex`. Arrow Up/Down move between enabled rows, Home/End jump to
the first/last, Enter and Space select the focused row, and typing letters jumps to the next row starting with them.

Besides rows, the default slot accepts `<hr>` dividers and `<h1>`–`<h6>` group headings; both are styled by the
`__divider` and `__heading` tokens and skipped by selection and keyboard.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected values. Written as `value="a;b"` in markup, read as `['a', 'b']` from the property.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dims the whole list and ignores clicks and keyboard.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow several rows to be selected; clicking a selected row deselects it.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Keep at least one row selected: clicking the only selected row does nothing.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The rows: `c2-list-item` elements (or wrappers whose first child is a `c2-list-item`), plus `<hr>` dividers and heading elements.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user changes the selection. `detail.value` is the array of selected values, `detail.data` the matching `data` of each row.

cssProperties.name: --c2-list--max-height
cssProperties.description: Scrolls when the rows are taller than this.

list-item.title: List Item
list-item.description: Selectable row with icon slots, used on its own or as the option of list and select.
list-item.intro: `c2-list-item` is the row that `c2-list` and `c2-select` are built from. On its own it is a self-contained toggle: a click, Enter or Space flips `selected` and fires `selected-change`. Inside a `c2-list` the list takes over: it matches each row's `value` against its own, sets `selected` for you and handles the keyboard, so rows in a list never carry the attribute themselves. The default slot is the content, `description` a second muted line; `prefix-icon` and `suffix-icon` take an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon` and are sized by `--c2-list-item__icon--size`. `href` turns the row into a link. `label` is the short text a select shows in its trigger when the row content is richer than a line of text. Rows expose `role="button"` with `aria-pressed` on their own and `role="option"` with `aria-selected` inside a list, and draw a focus ring for keyboard users.

elements.description:
A selectable row. On its own it is a toggle: click, Enter or Space flips `selected`. Inside a `c2-list` (and
therefore inside a `c2-select`) the list drives the selected state through context, handles the keyboard and the row
only reports clicks. The default slot is the primary text, `description` a second, muted line, `prefix-icon` and
`suffix-icon` take an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon` and are sized by `--c2-list-item__icon--size`.
With `href` the row is a link. In a multiple-selection list, adjacent selected rows lose the corner radius between
them (the list marks them `joined-before` / `joined-after`) so a run of selected rows reads as one block.

Accessibility: standalone rows are `role="button"` with `aria-pressed`; rows in a list are `role="option"` with
`aria-selected` and a roving `tabindex` managed by the list. Set your own `role` to override.

attributes.name: selected
attributes.description: Whether the row is selected. Toggled by a click on a standalone row; controlled by the list otherwise.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dims the row and ignores clicks and keyboard.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: The value reported to the parent list / select.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description:
Text shown by the parent select for this row instead of the slotted content. Also the fallback content of the
default slot when it is empty. Use it when the row content is rich (icons, two lines) but the trigger should show a
short label.

attributes.name: href
attributes.description: Makes the row a link. Selection still works when the row sits in a list.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The row content. Falls back to `label`, then `value`, when empty.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Secondary line under the content (muted, smaller).

slots.name: prefix-icon
slots.description: Icon (or avatar, badge, …) shown before the content.

slots.name: suffix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown after the content, e.g. a check mark or shortcut hint.

events.name: selected-change
events.description: Fired after `selected` changes, whether from a click or from the parent list.

modal.title: Modal
modal.description: Dialog built on the native dialog element: focus trap, backdrop, Escape, title, body and footer.
modal.intro: `c2-modal` wraps a native `<dialog>` opened with `showModal()`, so focus is trapped and restored, the page behind is inert and covered by a backdrop, and Escape closes. Open it with the `open` attribute or `show()`; close it with `close(returnValue)`, the built-in × button, a backdrop click or Escape, each of which `hide-close`, `no-backdrop-close` and `no-escape` can turn off. Put the heading in the `title` slot (it labels the dialog; use `label` when there is none), the content in the default slot (it scrolls past `--c2-modal--max-height`) and the actions in `footer`. `close` fires with `detail.returnValue`, `open` after showing. The page stops scrolling while a modal is open unless `no-scroll-lock` is set.

elements.description:
Modal dialog built on the native `<dialog>` element: focus is trapped and restored, Escape closes, the page behind
is inert and covered by a backdrop. Open it with the `open` attribute or `show()`, close it with `close(returnValue)`,
the built-in close button, a click on the backdrop or Escape (each can be turned off). Content is split into a
`title` slot, the body (default slot) and a `footer` slot for actions; the body scrolls when the content is taller
than `--c2-modal--max-height`. While a modal is open the page does not scroll (`no-scroll-lock` opts out).

attributes.description: Hide the built-in × button.

attributes.name: no-scroll-lock
attributes.description: Leave the page scrollable while the dialog is open.

events.description: Fired after the dialog has been shown.

overlay.title: Overlay
overlay.description: Anchored popup built on the browser Popover API, positioned with floating-ui.
overlay.intro: `c2-overlay` is a positioning shell around the browser Popover API. It lives in the top layer, opens and light-dismisses natively (Escape, click outside, `popover="manual"` to opt out), and floating-ui keeps it next to its anchor: the element whose `popovertarget` is the overlay's `id`, or whatever the `anchor` attribute (an id) or property (an element) points at. The preferred `placement` flips and shifts to stay on screen; the one in use is reflected as `current-placement`, and `--c2-overlay--available-height` / `--available-width` tell the content how much room it has. The overlay is at least as wide as its anchor unless `free-width` is set, and exactly as wide with `fit-anchor`. The slotted content brings its own surface. `c2-select` and `c2-color-select` are built on it.

elements.description:
Anchored popup built on the browser Popover API: the element sits in the top layer, opens and light-dismisses
natively (Escape, click outside) and is positioned next to its anchor with floating-ui. The anchor is found in
this order: the `anchor` property (an element), the `anchor` attribute (an element id in the same tree), or the
element whose `popovertarget` points at this overlay's `id`. The overlay only positions itself; the content brings
its own surface (background, border, shadow), so it fits menus, pickers and cards alike.

The preferred `placement` may flip or shift to stay in the viewport; the placement actually used is exposed as the
`current-placement` attribute, and the space available on that side as `--c2-overlay--available-height` /
`--c2-overlay--available-width` custom properties (use them to cap a scrolling list).

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Open state, kept in sync with the native popover (setting it shows or hides the popover).

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: Preferred placement (floating-ui names). The one in use is reflected as `current-placement`.

attributes.name: disabled-cross-axis
attributes.description: Do not flip across the cross axis when there is no room (only along the main axis).

attributes.name: fit-anchor
attributes.description: Make the overlay exactly as wide as the anchor.

attributes.name: free-width
attributes.description: By default the overlay is at least as wide as its anchor; set this to size it by its content only.

attributes.name: anchor
attributes.description: Anchor element, or (attribute) the id of the anchor. Falls back to the element whose `popovertarget` is this overlay's id.

slots.description: Content of the overlay.

events.name: toggle
events.description: Native popover toggle: `newState` is `open` or `closed`.

events.name: beforetoggle
events.description: Native, cancelable, fired before the state changes.

cssProperties.name: --c2-overlay--offset-y
cssProperties.description: Distance between the anchor and the overlay along the main axis.

cssProperties.name: --c2-overlay--offset-x
cssProperties.description: Shift along the cross axis (towards the end for `*-start`, the start for `*-end`).

cssProperties.name: --c2-overlay--viewport-padding
cssProperties.description: Minimum gap kept between the overlay and the viewport edges.

cssProperties.name: --c2-overlay--transition-duration
cssProperties.description: Open/close fade and scale; `0ms` disables it.

cssProperties.name: --c2-overlay__backdrop--background
cssProperties.description: The `::backdrop` behind the popover.

radio.title: Radio
radio.description: Radio options built on native inputs, grouped into one value with keyboard navigation.
radio.intro: `c2-radio` is one option: a native `<input type="radio">` with its label beside it and an optional `description` slot underneath. `c2-radio-group` turns several of them into a single control with one `value` and one `name`, disables them together, and restores the native keyboard model across the shadow boundary: Arrow keys move and select, and only the selected option is a tab stop. Radios can sit anywhere inside the group, including in wrapper elements. Standalone radios sharing a `name` in the same root still uncheck each other, but only the group provides arrow-key navigation and a single `change` event with the new value.

elements.description:
A single radio option built on a native `<input type="radio">`, with its label and an optional description beside
the control. Put several in a `c2-radio-group` to get a single `value`, arrow-key navigation and a roving tab stop;
standalone radios that share a `name` in the same document or shadow root still uncheck each other. Theme the
control, the label and the whole row (`container`), which turns a radio into a selectable card. The indicator is
not tied to the ring: the `dot` slot swaps the inner mark, and `icon` / `checked-icon` replace the control with
any icon per state.

attributes.name: checked
attributes.description: Whether this option is selected. Checking one radio unchecks the others of its group.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables this option. A disabled `c2-radio-group` disables every radio inside it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Value reported by the group and by the inner input. Every radio of a group needs one.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name. Inside a group, the group's `name` wins.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Label text when the default slot is empty.

slots.description: Label text. Falls back to the `label` attribute.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text shown under the label.

slots.name: dot
slots.description: Mark inside the ring while checked (an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon`). Replaces the filled dot.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: Replaces the ring with your own indicator. Shown while unchecked, and while checked too unless `checked-icon` is set.

slots.name: checked-icon
slots.description: Indicator shown while checked, replacing the ring and dot. Without `icon` the default ring still shows while unchecked.

events.name: change
events.description: Re-dispatched from the inner input when the user checks this radio.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__container--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the control and the text.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__container--flex-direction
cssProperties.description: `row-reverse` puts the indicator after the text, e.g. a trailing check mark.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__container--border
cssProperties.description: Set a border and padding for a card-style option.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__control--border-radius
cssProperties.description: Shape of the ring and its dot; `4px` gives a square control.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__control__checked--border
cssProperties.description: Transparent so the fill shows through; set an accent border with a transparent fill for an outlined look.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__dot--color
cssProperties.description: Fill of the dot, or `currentColor` of a slotted `dot` mark.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__icon--size
cssProperties.description: Size of slotted `icon` / `checked-icon` content. Falls back to the control size.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__icon--color
cssProperties.description: Colour of the slotted indicator while unchecked.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__icon__checked--color
cssProperties.description: Colour of the slotted indicator while checked.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__state-layer--size
cssProperties.description: Touch target around the control; also the hover layer.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio__state-layer__hover--color
cssProperties.description: Tint of the hover layer; transparent unless set.

elements.description:
Groups `c2-radio` options into one control: a single `value`, one `name` for every option, group-level `disabled`,
and keyboard behaviour that matches native radios across the shadow boundary (Arrow keys move and select, only the
selected option is a tab stop). Radios may sit anywhere inside the group, wrapped in other elements. The `label`
and `description` slots name the group for assistive technology (`role="radiogroup"`).

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: `value` of the checked option; empty when none is checked. Setting it checks the matching option.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name applied to every option.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables every option.

attributes.name: orientation
attributes.description: Lays the options out in a row instead of a column.

slots.description: The `c2-radio` options, optionally inside wrapper elements.

slots.name: label
slots.description: Group heading, announced as the group's name.

slots.name: description
slots.description: Supporting text under the heading.

events.name: change
events.description: Fired after the user selects another option. `detail.value` is the new `value`. Not fired for programmatic changes.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio-group--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between options.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio-group--align-items
cssProperties.description: `stretch` makes card-style options fill the width.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio-group__header--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the label and the description.

cssProperties.name: --c2-radio-group__header--margin-bottom
cssProperties.description: Space between the header and the options.

select.title: Select
select.description: Dropdown that pairs a themeable trigger with an anchored list of c2-list-item options.
select.intro: `c2-select` is a trigger button plus a popover. The options are plain `c2-list-item` children, so everything you know about list items applies here: `value` identifies an option, `label` gives the trigger a short text when the row content is rich, `disabled` greys a row out, and the `prefix-icon` / `suffix-icon` slots decorate it. Inside the popover the rows live in a `c2-list` that owns the selection, keeps the dropdown open in `multiple` mode and lists every selected label in the trigger. The dropdown is a native popover on the top layer, positioned by `c2-overlay`, so it flips above the trigger near the bottom of the viewport and is never clipped by an `overflow: hidden` parent.

elements.description:
A dropdown built from a trigger button and a `c2-list` of `c2-list-item` rows inside a `c2-overlay` popover. The
rows are the light-DOM children of the select, so they are themed with the `--c2-list-item--*` variables directly on
the select (or on a wrapper); the dropdown container is themed through the `--c2-select__list--*` variables and the
trigger through `--c2-select__button--*`. The select has no intrinsic width: give the host a `width` (or place it in
a grid/flex cell) and the trigger fills it.

attributes.name: open
attributes.description: Whether the dropdown is showing. Reflects the popover state; set it to open or close programmatically.

attributes.name: readonly
attributes.description: Shows the current value but never opens the dropdown.

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Dims the trigger and ignores interaction.

attributes.name: focused
attributes.description: True while the trigger has keyboard focus.

attributes.name: fit-size
attributes.description: Make the dropdown exactly as wide as the trigger instead of at least as wide.

attributes.name: placeholder
attributes.description: Text shown in the trigger while nothing is selected.

attributes.name: multiple
attributes.description: Allow several options to be selected; the dropdown stays open after a pick and the trigger lists every label.

attributes.name: required
attributes.description: Keep at least one option selected: picking the only selected option again does not clear it.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Selected values. Written as `value="a;b"` in markup, read as `['a', 'b']` from the property.

slots.name: default
slots.description: The options: `c2-list-item` elements, each with a `value`.

slots.name: button-prefix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown at the start of the trigger: an inline SVG, a `c2-feather-*` icon or a `c2-mat-icon`.

slots.name: button-suffix-icon
slots.description: Icon shown at the end of the trigger. Defaults to a chevron that flips while open.

slots.name: button-content
slots.description: Replaces the trigger text entirely (selected labels or placeholder) with custom markup.

events.name: selection-change
events.description: Fired after the user picks an option. `detail.value` is the array of selected values (one entry unless `multiple`), `detail.data` the `data` of each selected row.

cssProperties.name: --c2-select__button--gap
cssProperties.description: Space between the icons and the text.

cssProperties.name: --c2-select__button__prefix-icon--color
cssProperties.description: Defaults to the trigger text colour.

cssProperties.name: --c2-select__list--max-height
cssProperties.description: The dropdown scrolls past this height.

items.name: Soft filled
items.description: Grey fill, no border, larger radius.

items.name: Pill
items.description: Fully rounded trigger, dropdown and rows.

items.name: Underline
items.description: Only a bottom border; brand colour while open.

items.name: Brand outline
items.description: Violet border, text and selected rows.

items.name: Dark
items.description: Near-black trigger with a matching dark dropdown.

items.name: Compact
items.description: Shorter trigger and rows, 13px text.

items.name: Flat rows
items.description: Edge-to-edge rows with an accent bar on the selected one.

seperator.title: Seperator
seperator.description: Horizontal or vertical rule with an optional label, for dividing content and toolbars.
seperator.intro: `c2-seperator` draws a thin rule between pieces of content. It fills the width by default and stretches to the height of a flex row with `orientation="vertical"`. Slotted text becomes a label between two line segments, centred unless you shrink the first segment. It is `role="separator"` for assistive technology; add `decorative` for the purely visual dividers of a list or toolbar so screen readers skip them. Thickness, colour and line style are variables, and `spacing` and `inset-*` control the margins across and along the line.

elements.description:

side-nav.title: Side Nav
side-nav.description: Responsive navigation drawer beside the page: pushes the content on large screens, slides over it with a backdrop on small ones.
side-nav.intro: `c2-side-nav` is an app-shell layout: the drawer goes in the `side-nav-content` slot, the page in the default slot, and both stretch to the host's height. It has two display modes. In **side** mode the drawer is part of the layout: it collapses to `--c2-side-nav__close--width` (0 by default, or a rail) and pushes the content. In **over** mode it leaves the flow, slides over the content with a backdrop, locks page scrolling, behaves as a dialog for assistive technology and closes on Escape or a click outside. Phones (under 600px) always use over mode; `tablet-mode` (600 to 959px, `over` by default) and `desktop-mode` (960px and up, `side` by default) choose the mode for the larger breakpoints. When the viewport crosses a breakpoint the drawer closes or reopens by itself and remembers your choice; on phones the initial `opened` is ignored so the overlay never covers the page on load.

elements.description:
A layout shell with a navigation drawer beside the page content. The drawer goes in the `side-nav-content` slot, the
page in the default slot, and the host stretches both to its own height. In `side` mode the drawer collapses in the
flow and pushes the content; in `over` mode it slides over the content with a backdrop, locks page scrolling, traps
focus as a dialog and closes on Escape or a backdrop click. Phones always use `over`; `tablet-mode` and
`desktop-mode` pick the mode for the two larger breakpoints (600px and 960px), and the drawer remembers whether it
was open when the viewport crosses them.

Any element inside the side nav (drawer or content) carrying a `side-nav-toggle` attribute toggles the nearest enclosing side nav when
clicked, so a menu button in the page or a collapse button in the drawer header needs no script. With a non-zero
`--c2-side-nav__close--width` the collapsed drawer becomes an icon rail; the reflected `opened` attribute lets your
CSS hide the labels in that state (`c2-side-nav:not([opened]) .label { display: none }`).

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.description: Tab strip that shows one content panel at a time.
tabs.intro: `c2-tabs` pairs a row of `c2-tab` headers with content panels. Every `<c2-tab for="…">` child becomes a tab; every other child is a panel and is shown when its `id` matches the tab's `for`. Set the initial tab with `selected-tab`, or leave it out to start on the first enabled tab. The strip is a proper `tablist`: Left/Right arrows, Home and End move between tabs (disabled tabs are skipped), Enter and Space activate. Tab labels are slotted content, so an icon component (`c2-feather-*`, `c2-mat-icon`) or an inline SVG can sit next to, or instead of, the text; give icon-only tabs an `aria-label`. It fires `change` (`detail.value`) after a user picks a tab; listen for the cancelable `tab-change` from a `c2-tab` and call `preventDefault()` to veto a switch.

elements.description:
Tab strip that shows one content panel at a time.

Light-DOM children are split in two groups: every `<c2-tab for="…">` becomes a tab in the header

text-field.title: Text Field

text-field.intro: `c2-text-field` wraps a native `<input>`, so `type`, `name`, `autocomplete`, `maxlength`, `pattern`, `required` and the `input` / `change` events behave like the built-in control. tooltip.title: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Contextual hint shown when its target is hovered or focused, rendered in the top layer.
tooltip.intro: `c2-tooltip` describes the element it sits in: drop it inside a button and the button is the target, or point it at another element with `for="<id>"`. It shows after `delay` milliseconds on hover or focus and hides on leave, blur, press or Escape. The text is the slotted content, or the target's `data-tooltip` attribute when the slot is empty. It renders as a `popover` in the top layer, so it is never clipped by `overflow: hidden` or scrolling ancestors, and floating-ui flips the preferred `placement` when there is no room (the side in use is reflected as `current-placement`). The tooltip has `role="tooltip"` and the target gets `aria-describedby`, so screen readers announce it. `c2-icon-button` uses it for its `tooltip` attribute.

elements.description:
Contextual hint shown when its target is hovered or focused. Drop it inside the element it describes (the parent is
the target), point it at another element with `for="<id>"`, or use `target-strategy="previousElement"`. The text is
the slotted content, or the target's `data-tooltip` attribute when the slot is empty.

The tooltip is a `popover="manual"` element: it renders in the top layer, so it is never clipped by scrolling or
`overflow: hidden` ancestors and the target is left untouched. floating-ui keeps it beside the target and flips it
when there is no room; the side in use is reflected as `current-placement`. It has `role="tooltip"` and the target
gets `aria-describedby`, so assistive technology reads it. Escape, pressing on the target, blur and leaving hide it.

guides.workflow:
# The c2n application workflow

Build screens from `@c2n/*` web components with as little code as possible. Three layers, applied in this order.

## 1. Theme once

- Install `@c2n/theme` next to the component packages you use.
- Import `@c2n/theme/theme.css` once at the application root (tokens + base theme). If the app already owns a token system, import only `@c2n/theme/base.css` and bridge your tokens onto the `--c2-theme--*` names.
- Override the tokens that differ from the defaults on `:root` (light) and under your dark-mode selector. About 35 tokens (`--c2-theme--color-primary`, `--c2-theme--radius-md`, `--c2-theme--font-family`, `--c2-theme--focus-ring`, …) drive every component.
- Never set component variables globally when a token exists for the job.

## 2. Use the tags directly

- Register an element with a side-effect import (`import '@c2n/button'`) at the application entry, or in the module that renders it.
- Write plain markup: `<c2-button>Save</c2-button>`. Attributes, slots and events come from the component API (MCP `get_component`, or `node_modules/@c2n/<name>/custom-elements.json`).
- Icons are components: `c2-feather-<name>` from `@c2n/feather-icons/icons/<name>.js`, sized and coloured through `--c2-feather-icon--size|color|stroke-width`.
- A component that appears once with the themed default look needs nothing else.

## 3. Name what repeats

The decision rule, cheapest first:

| Situation                                                                         | Do this                                                                                                      |
| --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| The element appears once, default look is fine                                    | plain tag                                                                                                    |
| Same look repeats, markup is otherwise plain                                      | **CSS-class variant**: a class that sets `--c2-<component>__…` variables                                     |
| Same look **and** the same attributes / slots / accessible name repeat            | **wrapper component** in your framework (Astro/React/Vue/Lit) that renders the c2 element                    |
| The variant must be its own tag (used from strings, other Lit templates, shipped) | **Lit subclass** of the component with the variables baked into `static styles`                              |
| Several c2 components plus some logic repeat                                      | **composed component**: children's variables set on `:host`/a class, attributes forwarded, events re-emitted |
| No c2 component fits                                                              | app-level component styled with the same `--c2-theme--*` tokens; never fork a package                        |

Every variant lives in one directory (`src/components/ui/`, `src/ui/`…), one file per variant, under the app's own prefix (`app-*`, `site-*`, `my-*`), never `c2-*`.

## 4. Verify

- Every element used is registered (no `HTMLUnknownElement`, no empty tags).
- `@c2n/theme` is imported exactly once; tokens overridden on `:root` and the dark selector.
- No `::part()` selectors (the components do not expose parts), no repeated inline `style="--c2-…"`.
- Every variable, attribute, slot and event name exists in the component API.
- Variant tags contain a hyphen and do not start with `c2-`.
- Light and dark both look right; build, lint and type-check pass.
guides.frameworks:
# Using c2n components per framework

All components are standard custom elements (Lit 3). Register with a side-effect import; then they are plain HTML.

## Plain HTML / Vite / any bundler

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@c2n/theme/theme.css'
  import '@c2n/button'
</script>
<c2-button>Save</c2-button>
```

With a bundler, put the imports in the entry module (`main.ts`). CSS imports work through the bundler's CSS handling.

## Lit

Import what you render at the top of the component module (`import '@c2n/text-field'`). Extend a component for a tag variant (`class AppField extends TextField`). Re-emit child events with `redispatchEvent` from `@c2n/core/dom-helper.js`. Set child variables in your `static styles` on `:host` or on a class.

## Astro

- Islands (`@astrojs/lit`): `import { Button } from '@c2n/button'` in the frontmatter, `<Button client:load>` in the template. SSR'd with declarative shadow DOM, hydrated on load. Pass **kebab-case attributes** only (a prop whose name matches an element property is set as a property and forces `defer-hydration`). A `client:only` island must not contain islands: its children end up in a `<template>` and nothing hydrates; the parent module registers the children instead.
- Plain tags + client script: `<c2-button>` in the template and `import '@c2n/button'` inside a `<script>`. Cheaper for repeated markup (no shadow-DOM copy per instance); guard the flash with `c2-button:not(:defined) { visibility: hidden }`.
- Scoped `<style>` does not reach elements rendered by child components; use `is:global` (or `:global()`) for variant classes.

## React 19

Custom elements work as JSX tags. React 19 passes primitive props as attributes and functions as event listeners for `on*` names; for custom events attach listeners with a `ref` (`ref.current.addEventListener('selection-change', …)`). Declare the tags in `JSX.IntrinsicElements` for TypeScript. React 18 and older: pass attributes as strings and use refs for events and properties.

## Vue

Tell the compiler about the tags: `compilerOptions.isCustomElement = (tag) => tag.startsWith('c2-')`. Bind attributes normally, listen with `@selection-change`. Use `.prop` modifier for array/object properties (`:value.prop="selected"`).

## Svelte / Angular

Svelte binds attributes and `on:` events directly. Angular needs `CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA` and `[attr.x]` / `(event)` bindings.

## Server-side rendering and static HTML

- Components must not touch `document`/`window` at module scope; the c2 components guard with `isServer`.
- Without SSR of the shadow DOM, hide unregistered tags until they upgrade: `c2-modal:not(:defined) { display: none }` (dialogs, lists) or `visibility: hidden` (layout-stable chrome).
- Theme CSS is plain CSS; load it in the document head so the first paint is themed.
